Hi @SchmidtDawid these options are not available, if you need to customise theses widgets in depth you will need to use the [connectors](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors.html) API.

There is a [guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/customization.html) explaining step by step how to customize widgets.
